decisions.reason: The DPA management tool costs little to maintain as software, received positive agency feedback, and supports the firm's compliance direction, so keeping the option open is cheap and sensible.
The management platform is featured on the home page and is central to the agency-focused strategy, so it has effectively moved past the option stage into core commitment.
The configurable managed plan sits close to the core hosting offer and runs on existing infrastructure, so keeping it costs little while its value is still emerging.

Extended PHP security support was launched recently and has had little time to show its value, and it addresses real customer needs around end-of-life PHP versions, but it may be time-limited by nature, so keeping it open for now while watching uptake is warranted.
